bio: Take a seat in the sleek, spacious dining hall framed by floor-to-ceiling windows and revel in the quintessential view over Paris: Comédie-Française, Conseil d’Etat, Louvre… The enticing menu cleverly slaloms between hearty victuals of unabashed Lyonnais parentage (hot pistachio sausage in a soft bread roll, pike quenelle and nantua sauce) and timeless brasserie staples (snails in garlic and parsley butter, sole meunière, etc.). The terrace beneath the arcades of this emblematic Haussmannian edifice is sheer bliss in fine weather....
